best_discovery_candidate.interpretation: Stratified start-panel estimate (128 each in rest/weak/wide/edge), not an IID population probability. The 85.35% pooled share exceeds the current numerical target, but the edge stratum is 97/128 (75.78%), the 214-um hollow sphere lacks a matching documented joint experimental material/charge/size record, and electrode-field breakdown margin remains unresolved. All 32 conditional long-horizon starts persisted through 240000 periods and exceeded 100 turns; this does not extend the basin estimate to that horizon.

superseded_best_discovery_candidate_hist.interpretation: One literature-constrained dimensional scenario assembled from separately reported ranges, not a measured joint pair; four distinct start ensembles and provisional late-window labels are not IID basin probabilities. final_comparative_validation.objective: Any strict sustained counterrotation direction (+−) or (−+) is success; no balance between directions required. Co-rotation, wall loss, axial loss, axis ambiguity, and unresolved motion remain separate outcomes.
final_comparative_validation.classification: Fresh-start RK4/64 for 15000 RF periods; strict direction requires consistent signs in three late windows and at least 10 net turns per particle. Four fixed ensembles have 128 starts each; these are stratified sample frequencies, not IID probabilities.

final_comparative_validation.scientific_status: No physically confirmed configuration is established. The scaled refine12 point clears 80% only as a dimensionless-preserving physical mapping; its 214 um hollow-sphere diameter is outside cited tested distributions and its electrode-field/breakdown qualification is unresolved. The better size-range-supported point phys0570 reaches 71.875%.
